records.title: Photonic Mixture-of-Experts for scalable multi-task on-chip optical neural networks
records.reason: The article implements a photonic MoE chip for multi-domain image classification, routing among optical expert networks; experiments report 97.1% average image-classification accuracy and reduced digital parameter overhead. It does not present LLM/MoE training or language-model inference systems, so the lineage overlap is only the generic MoE label.

records.title: Multi-scale feature fusion-based vision mamba for robust plant disease image classification on field-acquired plantdoc data
records.reason: This is a field-plant-disease Vision Mamba classifier; the primary article reports 31.4M parameters, 7.2 GFLOPs and 8.4 ms/image. The efficiency result is for a specialized vision classifier and does not concern LLM inference or the linked torch.compile system.
